scope: North Platte near Casper: guide credentials, the public sticker path, boat-number access, and one department access site
highest_priority_permission_question: Whether inspection and copying under Codified Law 16-4-202 and 16-4-204 authorize commercial-directory reuse of access-site facts or of a boat-sticker or watercraft-certificate record. Those sections were read. They require inspection and allow copies for a fee. They do not state a commercial-directory grant. The department footer asserts copyright 2026.
method: Primary pages and the current statute PDFs were read on 2026-11-25. Chapter 71 was read from the department PDF. The sticker address is a purchase login, and the trip-reporting address redirects to a login. No account was used. Three North Platte booking sites rendered. One other operator host returned HTTP 403 and was not retried. Operator URLs, personal names, and contact details are omitted from this file.

sources.field_scope: Saved lead. A current sticker is required before launching on a commercially guided fishing trip. Account login. Fee $325. Replacement fees $25 and $50. Up to 10 stickers in one transaction. States that specified personal identifiers are not public records and that other application information may be public. No account was used. Not a roster.

sources.field_scope: Describes the sticker, links Chapter 71 and a summary, and states twice-yearly reporting deadlines of July 15 and January 15. Lists an advisory board by district. Names and the printed board email were not copied. Not a registrant roster.

Signed regulation. Registrant is the purchaser. Boat sticker carries an identification number. Trailer sticker does not. Stickers may move between watercraft. A permanent sticker ends when the boat or trailer is transferred to a new owner. Records include registrant, sticker number, outfitter, boat operator, date, water, and river segment. Reports are due twice a year. Fishing guide services include angling and bowfishing. Fee $325.
sources.request_process: Records are submitted to the department. No report was filed.

sources.field_scope: 23-3-206 defines the commercially guided fishing boat and requires commission rules for annual registration beginning January 1, 2026. 23-2-407 requires an outfitter or professional guide license for big or trophy game, not for fishing. 23-1-706 withholds listed personally identifiable license information unless the applicant designates it public. 23-6-111 requires a permitted commercial operation to exhibit required records to department personnel. Not a roster.

sources.field_scope: State web pages are governed by Wyoming law. Information may be subject to Codified Law 16-4-201 and following. Visit logs are statistical and are not used to identify a person. sources.field_scope: 16-4-202(a) opens public records to inspection by any person at reasonable times during business hours, except as the act or another law provides. 16-4-203(a) requires inspection unless a state statute, a federal statute or regulation, or a later subsection withholds it. Later subsections of 16-4-203 were not finished. 16-4-204 allows copies for a reasonable custodian fee. Not a commercial-directory grant.

sources.field_scope: North Platte River-Mills Bridge. Open year round. Fire ban in effect on the check date. Parking and a primitive boat ramp. Commission easement in the town of Mills, used as a put-in for float trips through Casper. Hunting, trapping, camping, and fires prohibited. Winter parking is not plowed. The regional office street and phone were not copied.

sources.field_scope: Describes safety equipment and says operating an unregistered boat, failing to carry the certificate, or displaying numbers improperly are violations. A hull identification number is a federal identifier and must appear on the state certificate. Links an owner application and the online registration login. Not a public hull search.

Owner or co-owner login to register or renew for one or three years, valid through December 31 of the chosen term. A username has been required since February 4, 2021. The receipt is a temporary registration. An aquatic invasive species decal is offered in the same transaction. No account was used. Not a public search.

41-13-102 requires numbering of motorboats powered by machinery and operated on state waters, with stated exceptions in 41-13-103 that were not read. 41-13-104 requires an owner application, a certificate stating the number and the owner's name and address, and bow display of the number. Subsection (e) says records made under that section are public records. No application was filed.
